ton: Deutscher Erzähler. Die ersten fünf Absätze warm, ruhig, mitfühlend. Ab dem Absatz mit dem Fernglas im Ton eines klassischen Naturdokumentation-Sprechers: ruhig, staunend, leicht ironisch. Die letzten zwei Absätze wieder kraftvoll klar. An Absatzenden deutliche Pausen.

szenen.vo: Vier Wochen Auftrag. Herr Vogel und sein Team haben alles gegeben.
szenen.bild: Bright German old-building apartment mid-renovation: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) on a ladder painting a ceiling edge with perfect precision, while his young apprentice Timo (early twenties, red cap, white overalls) tapes a window frame and his experienced worker Sasha (forties, stocky, white overalls, dark beard) rolls a wall, drop cloths, warm daylight, diligent teamwork. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: All three work in quiet concentration, the master pulls a perfect line, the apprentice smooths the tape.
szenen.bild2: Close: the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) pointing critically at a freshly painted wall while master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) nods patiently and his young apprentice Timo (early twenties, red cap, white overalls) already fetches a new paint bucket, evening light in the renovated room. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: Bernd gestures demandingly at the wall, the master nods calmly, the apprentice hurries over with fresh paint.

szenen.vo: Jeder Sonderwunsch: erfüllt. Die Mitarbeiter: längst bezahlt.
szenen.bild: Same room now finished differently: the wall repainted in a new colour, the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) finally smiling smugly with crossed arms, master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) wiping his brow with quiet pride, ladder being folded. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: Bernd nods satisfied at the new colour, the master allows himself a tired proud smile.
szenen.bild2: At the grey work van in warm evening light: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) handing pay envelopes to his young apprentice Timo (early twenties, red cap, white overalls) and his experienced worker Sasha (forties, stocky, white overalls, dark beard), patting the apprentice on the shoulder, both smiling gratefully. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: He hands over the envelopes and pats Timo's shoulder, they nod thankfully and load the ladder.

szenen.bild: The gleaming finished apartment, golden hour: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) solemnly handing the invoice envelope to the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) at the door - and Bernd taking it slowly with a greasy smug smile, already leaning on the doorframe. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The invoice changes hands in slow deliberate motion, Bernd's smile widens greasily, the master's face begins to doubt.

szenen.vo: Drei Mahnungen später: immer noch nichts.
szenen.bild: Evening in a small German workshop office: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) at his desk under a work lamp, before him an open folder and three reminder letters fanned out, he rubs his forehead, worried but composed, tools on the wall behind. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: He fans out EXACTLY the three reminder letters that are already there and rubs his forehead, the lamp flickers slightly. IMPORTANT: no new papers appear, the number of letters stays exactly three for the entire shot, nothing multiplies.

szenen.vo: Dann findet er: Habicht Inkasso. Fall einreichen? Zwei Minuten. Rechnung rein, fertig.
szenen.bild: Close-up from the side: the weathered hands of master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt) typing slowly on a laptop keyboard at night in his workshop office, the screen softly glowing but out of focus, work lamp light, concentrated search. Distinctly GERMAN setting, nothing American.
szenen.motion: His fingers type a short search query, hesitate, then press enter with one decisive finger. The screen stays out of focus. His hands keep exactly the same appearance.
szenen.bild2: Close over the shoulder: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) at his laptop at night, on the softly glowing (defocused) screen the dark silhouette of a hawk logo, his face lit with new hope. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: He leans in, the hawk silhouette glows on the screen, his tired face lifts with hope.
szenen.bild3: Bright modern office counter: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) sliding a single folder with the invoice across the counter to Mr Gross (very tall broad man, shaved head, neat black beard, immaculate navy three-piece suit) and Mr Klein (short slim man, round glasses, side-parted hair, identical navy suit), Klein already reaching for it with white gloves like a precious artefact, Gross nodding solemnly. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion3: The folder slides across, Klein receives it with ceremony, a firm handshake between master and Gross. IMPORTANT: both suited men keep exactly the same faces, hairstyles and glasses for the entire shot, no changes to their appearance.

szenen.vo: Ab hier gilt: Zurücklehnen. Und einfach... beobachten.
szenen.bild: Mr Gross (very tall broad man, shaved head, neat black beard, immaculate navy three-piece suit) ceremoniously handing master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) a pair of binoculars, Mr Klein (short slim man, round glasses, side-parted hair, identical navy suit) beside them gesturing towards the window with a polite smile, warm office light - the invitation to simply watch. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The binoculars change hands ceremoniously, the master raises them to his eyes towards the window.

szenen.vo: Und hier sehen wir ihn: den Gemeinen Zahlungsverweigerer. In seinem natürlichen Revier.
szenen.bild: View as through documentary binoculars (soft dark vignette at the edges): the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) contentedly flipping sausages on his barbecue in his tidy German garden, garden gnome, trimmed hedge, vivid saturated colours. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: He flips a sausage with satisfaction and sips his beer, smoke drifts, the binocular view drifts slightly like a handheld observer.

szenen.vo: Er ahnt nicht: Die Natur kennt für jede Spezies einen Jäger.
szenen.bild: Same sunny German garden: the sharp shadow of a large hawk gliding across the lawn and over the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt), who looks up puzzled into an empty blue sky, grill tongs in hand. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The hawk shadow sweeps slowly across the lawn, he squints upwards, nothing there, he shrugs.
szenen.bild2: Extreme close-up of a majestic hawk's amber eye, hyper-detailed feathers, dramatic light, round pupil composition.
szenen.motion2: The eye blinks once slowly, light glints across the amber iris.

szenen.vo: Stufe eins: der Mahnbescheid vom Amtsgericht. Reaktion? Keine.
szenen.bild: Bright German front garden: a postal worker in blue-yellow uniform dropping a yellow official envelope into the letterbox at the fence, while the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) in his bathrobe watches from the front door. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The postal worker drops the envelope in and cycles off, Bernd shuffles over and pulls it out.
szenen.bild2: Close at the letterbox: the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) in his bathrobe glancing at the yellow envelope with the round window, then waving it off dismissively and tucking it unopened under his arm. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: He squints at the envelope, waves it off dismissively, tucks it under his arm and shuffles back.

szenen.vo: Stufe zwei: der Vollstreckungstitel. Gültig für dreißig Jahre.
szenen.bild: Bright German court office desk with oak wood and a brass lamp: a heavy official stamp SLAMMING down onto a document, loose calendar pages bursting upwards, dramatic low angle - a plain German office, no courtroom, no flags. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The stamp slams down hard, calendar pages explode upward and flutter down, quick punch-in on impact.
szenen.bild2: The German garden again: the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) at his barbecue - the hawk shadow on the lawn now TWICE as large and darker, covering half the garden. He looks up: empty sky. He swallows. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: The larger shadow glides over him, he spins around looking up, nothing, he swallows nervously.

szenen.vo: Stufe drei: die Sperren. Kein Kredit. Keine Karte. Und der Arbeitgeber? Liest mit.
szenen.bild: Bright German bank advisory office: a bank adviser turning a document face-down and shaking his head apologetically at the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt), closing the folder - no credit, polite but final. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The adviser turns the page down, closes the folder and shakes his head politely, Bernd deflates.
szenen.bild2: Bright German car showroom: a salesman retracting the car key with an apologetic grimace, red-marked file on the desk, the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) deflating before a gleaming car with German EU plate. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: The key is withdrawn apologetically, Bernd's hand stays outstretched in the air, empty.
szenen.bild3: Bright modern German office: a stern female boss lowering a formal letter, looking over her reading glasses at the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) in the doorway with his coffee mug, a colleague peeking curiously. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion3: She lowers the letter and stares over the glasses, he shrinks, the colleague's head disappears quickly.

szenen.vo: Stufe vier: der Gerichtsvollzieher. Und das Liebste? Versiegelt.
szenen.bild: Sunny German garden: a dutiful bailiff in a grey suit smoothing a large official seal sticker onto the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt)'s beloved yellow ride-on mower with the red gift bow, Bernd clutching his heart on the terrace. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: The bailiff smooths the seal with care and gives it a satisfied pat, Bernd gasps theatrically.

szenen.vo: Der Verweigerer erkennt: Der bequemste Ausweg... ist zahlen. Die freiwillige Übergabe.
szenen.bild: Bright German bank counter hall with sandstone columns: the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) at the counter pushing a filled transfer slip and his wallet across to the clerk, resigned but relieved, warm daylight. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: He pushes the slip across with a deep sigh, the clerk takes it with a friendly nod, his shoulders finally relax.
szenen.bild2: Through the documentary binocular vignette: the debtor Bernd (a chubby man in his fifties, walrus moustache, yellow polo shirt) leaving the bank noticeably lighter, almost cheerful, straightening his yellow polo shirt in the sun. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion2: He steps out, exhales, straightens his polo and walks off lighter - the binocular view follows him gently.

szenen.vo: Ihr Geld. Ohne Vorkosten. Die Gebühren trägt der Schuldner. Habicht Inkasso: der natürliche Feind offener Rechnungen.
szenen.bild: Warm bright workshop morning: master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) showing his phone with the payment confirmation to his young apprentice Timo (early twenties, red cap, white overalls) and his experienced worker Sasha (forties, stocky, white overalls, dark beard), all three grinning, then grabbing their gear for the next job, golden light. Distinctly GERMAN setting: German plaster facades, red clay roof tiles, German interior details - no American flags, no US architecture, nothing American.
szenen.motion: He holds up the phone, Timo pumps his fist, they grab ladders and rollers with fresh energy.
szenen.bild2: Grand finale movie poster in vivid orange and teal sunburst: a majestic hawk landing with fully spread wings at the top, below master painter Herr Vogel (late fifties, short grey hair, neat grey moustache, white painter's overalls over a checked shirt, calm dignified face) standing proudly in the centre flanked by Mr Gross (very tall broad man, shaved head, neat black beard, immaculate navy three-piece suit) and Mr Klein (short slim man, round glasses, side-parted hair, identical navy suit), heroic clean composition.
szenen.motion2: The hawk lands majestically with spread wings, coats ripple in the wind, slow confident push-in.
szenen.bild3: Extreme close-up: the hawk's head turning sharply to camera with fierce amber eyes, wings snapping shut, vivid orange sunburst behind.
szenen.motion3: The head snaps to camera, eyes lock on, wings fold with a sharp final movement.
